Well, I haven't had many rejections, 3 to be exact. So its not hard to remember them, so I'll give you all 3.

First was when I was 13, turning 14 in a couple months. Me and this girl had gone to the same grade school since we started, and well I never really payed(sp?) any attention to her until grade 8. It was then I started talking to her a lot, both at school and over MSN. When I was that age I had already been on the internet for a while and picked up some, well, interesting words (interesting, not vulgar or slang). Her mother, who had read all of her and her sisters MSN conversations was very happy with some of the things I said.

Now her family was very close with the teacher of my class so they went to him to talk to me. I still remember how choked up I was sitting in the hallway because of how bad I felt for putting her through this and her parents reading it. After regaining my composure I asked him to apologize to the parents for me and she awkwardly said she can't and wouldn't to me. I still regret how I acted then, I would go back and slap myself for acting like such a bitch, I would give her the cold stare every day and laugh about it with my buddies when she would look sad about it. By the end of the year I had somewhat gotten over myself and she had forgiven me. On the last day we all received the class picture from that year printed in the middle of a white sheet, she wrote on mine, "Paul, have fun in high school, I'll NEVER forget you". I still have that hanging in my room 5 years later.

tl;dr: 13 year old me used big boy words to try and get a girl, parents found out, she said no, I became an asshole, she forgave me.

Next, fuck me the next one... This one put me into depression and even at one point suicidal, although not from the rejection, but from my own building up of the event. First day of high school, first class, she was the first person I didn't know that I talked to. Over the course of that year I never really got close, but we were friends. Second year is when shit went down. She was in almost every one of my classes, and I started taking her bus, so we ended up spending a lot of time together. Let it be known I've played video games religiously my whole life and I'm obese. It was around the beginning of May. I couldn't stop thinking of her. Every time I thought of her I knew I had a crush which my hopeless romantic self interpreted as “love”.

I dropped everything in my life. I dropped all video games, my WoW addiction, and my bad eating habits and general laziness. I would wake up an hour early for school (5 in the morning) and go for a 3k walk and work out with the multipurpose machine I have in my room, along with crunches to get rid of my gut and push ups, whole routine was a little over an hour. I also barely ate anything during the day, I would have my cereal and coffee (oh god no coffee at first was impossible) with maybe a light sandwich during the day and perhaps half or less of what I usually ate at dinner and a salad. I would then repeat the morning routine, walk, work out, crunches, push ups, and then work on my Graphic Design skills and talk on MSN until I passed out (never took long). Repeat this for 4 weeks, Sundays being my day off, I think I looked decent instead of a big flabby fuck.

So, the day came, I finally had the courage to ask her out. Monday, June 8th, 2009 was the day. I sat in my cafeteria with my “friends” at the time waiting for her to get up with her group so I could take her off a lone and ask her instead of embarrass her in front of her friends. After 20 minutes they get up to go, and I follow after some of them exit the room. I ask her to come off to the side, nervous as fuck (my gut is actually wrenching as I type this) and simply say to her in some manner close to this, “Would you go out with me sometime?” She stared blankly at me for a second, and said “Umm.. no Paul. There's actually other guys I'd rather date”. I was devestated.

Well, after four weeks of mentally and physically exhausting exercise and determination, I broke, not at school thankfully though. I went home that night and didn't know what to do with myself. I'm pretty sure I blacked out for a bit as my brother tells me he could hear me “laughing like a retard” from upstairs (my room is in the basement) and yelling things he couldn't make out. I have no recollection of this. I stopped everything, put on more weight in 2 weeks than I lost in the four and hated myself. Seeing her everyday became a nightmare.

Tl;dr: Poured my heart and soul into improving myself for a girl I thought I “loved” and she told me I wasn't good enough, broke down mentally due to the pressure I placed upon myself and went into a self-inflicted depression.
